## Credential requested

- [ ] `badge: four-week AI Learning Hub graduate`
- [ ] Completion record
- [ ] Printable certificate wording

## Member name for recognition

Write the name or display name that you approve for badge or certificate use.

## Week 1 evidence

Link to or describe a sanitized low-risk task, improved prompt, verification action, and reflection.

## Week 2 evidence

Link to or describe a workflow canvas, human-review step, five-case test set, and improvement.

## Week 3 evidence

Link to or describe a bounded agent or retrieval-system design, approved-source plan, evaluation set, and limitation.

## Week 4 capstone role and evidence

State your role, your contribution, and a link to a sanitized artifact, demonstration, or reflection.

## What I verified or changed myself

Describe one or more specific actions.

## One limitation I discovered

Name one boundary, uncertainty, or failure case.

## One responsible next step

Describe one focused improvement, test, or learning goal.

## Safe-sharing confirmation

- [ ] I used only fictional, anonymized, or authorized public material.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, private data, client information, or unauthorized content.
- [ ] I understand that this credential recognizes curriculum completion and community practice; it is not a professional certification or authorization to deploy high-impact AI systems.
